About

I'm an Assistant Product Manager working at the intersection of product management and data — supporting the end-to-end product lifecycle, translating business and user needs into PRDs and acceptance criteria, and turning behavioral data into roadmap decisions for platforms used by millions.

My path has run through recruitment technology at Bdjobs.com, mobility at Jatri, and now Arogga — giving me working fluency in HR-tech matching systems, ride-sharing operations and digital platforms, always with SQL, Tableau, and Metabase close at hand.

I'm now looking toward advanced study in SME development and digital innovation, to sharpen how I help small and growing businesses in Bangladesh make data-informed decisions.
